title: pinout-openapi contract-tests.yaml — input config DTO
description: Frozen input contract (config DTO) of the pinout-openapi compatibility-check CLI. This is the CLI-profile equivalent of a service's frozen OpenAPI: the single documented boundary for every external input the tool accepts (Design by Contract — the caller's preconditions). Serialized as YAML (contract-tests.yaml) but shape-validated by this JSON Schema. Derived 1:1 from BRD 'Data dictionary — input config'. Every fit criterion here is a committed constraint; a violation maps to CONFIG_INVALID (exit 2) unless a more specific I/O error.code applies (see exit-codes.md).

consumer.description: The expectations side: the OpenAPI spec whose consumer expectations must be satisfiable by the provider.

spec_path.description: Filesystem path to a local OpenAPI 3.x document readable and parseable by kin-openapi. Missing/unreadable → SPEC_UNREADABLE (exit 2); unparseable/not OpenAPI 3.x → SPEC_PARSE_ERROR (exit 2).

name.description: Free-form consumer label; MUST be non-empty after trim (\S ensures at least one non-whitespace char).

operations.description: Operations the consumer expects to be compatible. At least one item; an empty list is a config error.

path.description: OpenAPI path key, leading '/'. Must be present in the consumer spec at runtime; absent from consumer spec → OP_NOT_IN_CONSUMER (exit 2).

method.description: OpenAPI verb, one of {get,put,post,delete,options,head,patch,trace}. Case-insensitive on input (Postel), normalized to lower-case by the CLI before comparison. Canonical (normalized) values are the lower-case forms.

provider.description: The source-of-truth side: the provider master (= prod) OpenAPI spec. Its origin is exactly one of spec_url (HTTP(S) GET) or spec_path (local file).

spec_url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the provider master OpenAPI 3.x spec. Unauthenticated fetch (MVP), bounded by settings.timeout. Mutually exclusive with spec_path — exactly one MUST be present. Unreachable/non-2xx → PROVIDER_UNREACHABLE (exit 3); fetch exceeds timeout → PROVIDER_TIMEOUT (exit 3).

spec_path.description: Local filesystem path to the provider master OpenAPI 3.x spec. Mutually exclusive with spec_url — exactly one MUST be present. Missing/unreadable → SPEC_UNREADABLE (exit 2); unparseable → PROVIDER_PARSE_ERROR (exit 3).

name.description: Free-form provider label; MUST be non-empty after trim.

settings.description: Optional run settings; every field has a committed default. An omitted 'settings' block is equivalent to all defaults.

save_json_report.description: When true, the JSON report is also written to json_report_file (the machine-readable stdout line is always emitted regardless). Default true.

json_report_file.description: Writable path for the JSON report. Required when save_json_report is true (see the conditional below); the app substitutes the default 'compatibility_report.json' only as a documented fallback. Write failure → REPORT_WRITE_ERROR (exit 3).

timeout.description: Provider HTTP(S) fetch timeout in seconds, integer in [1,600] inclusive. Default 30.

then.description: save_json_report defaults to true, so unless it is explicitly false, json_report_file MUST be present (missing while required → CONFIG_INVALID).
